chapter: Second reel: instrument, style and wrap-up
title: His brother Henry 'Stanks' Nelson
summary: Nelson says his brother played in bands mostly in Raceland, died about twenty years ago, and was known as Stanks.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did your brother play much in bands when he came up here?
Yeah, he played in some bands up here. But he mostly was in Raceland. He didn't have bands? I don't know what band he'd be in up there, you see.
Yeah. Never could keep up with him. Mm-hmm. But he's not alive now?
No, he died. When did he die about?
He must have been, he been dead about 20 years now. Quite a long time.
Mm-hmm. Yeah. You gave us his name, did you, before?
Yeah, Henry Nelson. Henry, that's right.
Stanks. Oh yeah, yeah. It was called his nickname, Stanks.
They all call him that, I remember, I've heard people talk about it. Mm-hmm.
